# Ropework

> Ropework is a desktop client for Perforce Helix Core, made for studios. Artists get a simple layout, experts get a full one, in the same window. It is free during the beta and runs on Windows 11. Ubuntu 24.04 is planned. The source code is private; downloads, guides and release notes are public.

## Use it
- [Download the beta](https://p4inz-code.github.io/ropework/download/): installer and portable zip with SHA-256 checksums
- [Features](https://p4inz-code.github.io/ropework/features/)
- [Screens](https://p4inz-code.github.io/ropework/screens/): real screens in light and dark
- [Migrate from P4V](https://p4inz-code.github.io/ropework/migrate/)
- [Pricing](https://p4inz-code.github.io/ropework/pricing/): the beta is free; plans are priced by seat count after it
